say:1:1130320001:1.text: Every evening we gather here to sit in the sand and share a meal.
say:1:1130320001:1.source_cn: 每到黄昏时分，大家就会聚在这里，一起坐在沙堆上吃饭，我...
say:1:1130320001:1.male: Every evening we gather here to sit in the sand and share a meal.
say:1:1130320001:1.female: Every evening we gather here to sit in the sand and share a meal.

say:2:1130320002:1.text: Then we chat about everyone's day. Haha, sometimes we wind up chewing on the sand from the wind.
say:2:1130320002:1.source_cn: 然后聊聊大家每天发生的事。哈哈，偶尔还会嚼到风中卷来的砂砾。
say:2:1130320002:1.male: Then we chat about everyone's day. Haha, sometimes we wind up chewing on the sand from the wind.
say:2:1130320002:1.female: Then we chat about everyone's day. Haha, sometimes we wind up chewing on the sand from the wind.

say:3:1130320003:1.text: The sky darkens as we talk and the stars slowly light up the desert.
say:3:1130320003:1.source_cn: 聊着聊着天就会暗下来，远处的星星就会亮起来。
say:3:1130320003:1.male: The sky darkens as we talk and the stars slowly light up the desert.
say:3:1130320003:1.female: The sky darkens as we talk and the stars slowly light up the desert.

say:4:1130320004:1.text: It doesn't get any better than this.
say:4:1130320004:1.male: It doesn't get any better than this.
say:4:1130320004:1.female: It doesn't get any better than this.
